p.src: Overview: Vacuum energy is unlike ordinary matter: it neither selects a preferred inertial frame nor dilutes as the universe expands. Once gravity is included, that apparently innocuous zero of energy changes the geometry of spacetime. We shall derive the matter-dominated law $a(t)\propto t^{2/3}$, contrast it with the vacuum-dominated law $a(t)\propto e^{Ht}$, and then rewrite de Sitter spacetime in conformal coordinates. The resulting causal diagram reveals an observer-dependent event horizon at fixed proper distance.

p.src: The harmonic oscillator gives the cleanest model. Classically it can remain motionless at the minimum of its potential. Quantum mechanically, exact position at the minimum and exact zero momentum are incompatible. The ground state compromises between the two and retains the zero-point energy $E_0=\frac{1}{2}\hbar\omega.$ This is the least energy the oscillator can have. It is not an excited state and does not represent a stream of observable particles.

p.src: We must distinguish a symmetry of the laws from a symmetry of a particular state. The equations of physics may be translation invariant even though Stanford is not Berkeley and Earth is not interstellar space. Translating the entire physical arrangement leaves the laws unchanged; the actual arrangement of matter need not look the same at every location. Likewise, rotationally invariant equations do not make this classroom rotationally symmetric.

ja: 法則の対称性と特定の状態の対称性を区別しなければならない。物理学の方程式は並進不変でありえても、スタンフォードはバークリーではなく、地球は星間空間ではない。物理的配置全体を並進させても法則は変わらない。物質の実際の配置は、あらゆる場所で同じに見える必要はない。同様に、回転不変な方程式はこの教室を回転対称にするものではない。
zh: 我们必须把定律的对称性与某个特定状态的对称性区分开来。物理方程可以是平移不变的，尽管斯坦福不是伯克利，地球也不是星际空间。平移整个物理安排会使定律保持不变；而物质的实际安排不必在每个位置看起来都一样。同样地，旋转不变的方程并不会使这间教室具有旋转对称性。

p.src: The same distinction applies to Lorentz transformations. A gas has a rest frame. An observer moving through it sees moving molecules and a different energy density, so the state of the gas is not Lorentz invariant even though its governing equations are. Ordinary matter, radiation baths, and laboratory apparatus all break the symmetry by selecting special motions or directions.

ja: 同じ区別がローレンツ変換にも当てはまる。気体には静止系がある。それを通り抜けて運動する観測者は運動する分子と異なるエネルギー密度を見るので、気体の状態は、それを支配する方程式がローレンツ不変であっても、ローレンツ不変ではない。通常の物質、放射浴、実験装置はすべて、特別な運動や方向を選び出すことによって対称性を破る。
zh: 同样的区分也适用于洛伦兹变换。气体有一个静止系。穿过它运动的观测者会看到运动的分子和不同的能量密度，因此气体的状态不是洛伦兹不变的，尽管支配它的方程是洛伦兹不变的。普通物质、辐射浴以及实验室装置都通过选出特殊的运动或方向而破坏了这一对称性。

p.src:
Vacuum energy is the exceptional form of matter that does not do so. Imagine a detector that reports the vacuum-energy density. It gives some value $\rho_{\rm vac}$ while at rest. Accelerate the detector and repeat the measurement: the result is unchanged. In relativistic notation this property is encoded by a stress tensor proportional to the metric, $T_{\mu\nu}^{\rm vac}=-\rho_{\rm vac}g_{\mu\nu},
\qquad
p_{\rm vac}=-\rho_{\rm vac}.$  (Editorial clarification: The pressure relation is not derived on the board. It is the covariant statement behind the lecture’s two defining properties: Lorentz invariance and constant density during expansion.)

p_{\rm vac}=-\rho_{\rm vac}.$  (Editorial clarification: The pressure relation is not derived on the board. It is the covariant statement behind the lecture’s two defining properties: Lorentz invariance and constant density during expansion.)

p.src: Fill a large region with nonrelativistic particles of mass $m$. On scales large enough to average over galaxies and clusters, suppose the distribution is homogeneous. If a comoving volume contains $N$ particles, its matter density is $\rho_m=\frac{Nm}{V}.$ When every linear dimension doubles, the volume grows by $2^3=8$, while $N$ and $m$ remain unchanged. Thus the density falls to one eighth of its former value. Ordinary matter dilutes because the same particles occupy a larger physical volume.

p.src:
We now choose the simplest homogeneous expanding geometry with flat spatial slices: $ds^2=-dt^2+a(t)^2\,d\mathbf{x}^2,
\qquad
d\mathbf{x}^2=dx^2+dy^2+dz^2.$ The coordinate marks $\mathbf{x}$ are painted on an infinite rubber sheet. They need not move, but their physical separations do. Two comoving points separated by $\Delta\mathbf{x}$ have proper distance at fixed $t$ $D(t)=a(t)\lvert\Delta\mathbf{x}\rvert.$ Thus all the time dependence of this highly symmetric geometry is stored in one function, the scale factor $a(t)$. Constant $a$ gives flat Minkowski spacetime after a spatial rescaling. Time-dependent $a$ can leave each spatial slice flat while making the full spacetime curved.

E_{\rm received}=h\nu_{\rm received}\longrightarrow0.$ Bob’s image slows, reddens, and fades. The limiting signal carries vanishing usable information.

p.src: The lecture therefore closes at a precise boundary. Vacuum energy has produced exponential expansion; exponential expansion has produced a fixed, observer-dependent event horizon; and signals near that horizon have been driven to vanishing frequency. The horizon’s temperature and Hawking radiation belong to what comes next. Assuming, as Susskind says, that we do not cross one another’s horizons, we meet again in the next lecture.

ja: したがって講義は、正確な境界で終わる。真空エネルギーが指数的膨張を生み、指数的膨張が固定された観測者依存の事象の地平面を生み、そしてその地平面の近くの信号は振動数がゼロになるまで追いやられた。地平面の温度とホーキング放射は次に来るものに属する。ススキンドが言うように、我々が互いの地平面を横切らないと仮定すれば、次の講義でまた会おう。
zh: 因此讲座在一个精确的边界处结束。真空能产生了指数膨胀；指数膨胀产生了一个固定的、依赖于观测者的事件视界；而该视界附近的信号已被驱动到趋于零的频率。视界的温度和Hawking辐射属于接下来的内容。正如Susskind所说，假设我们不会越过彼此的视界，我们将在下一讲再见。
